The ACTUAL login mechanics (fill username, fill password, click login, wait for the app to load) on the CURRENT page - the ONE place to update if EC's login flow ever changes (a new SSO step, MFA, a renamed field id). Login To EC and Bank's own Login To EC Application (bank_page.resource) both call this instead of duplicating the steps, so a future flow change is a one-place edit (owner-requested 2026-08-18, after Bank's wrapper was found to have copy-pasted this sequence instead of reusing it).

Authenticate on the CURRENT page with ${user}/${pass}, then capture the login evidence screenshot. Shared body for every screen's own zero-arg "Login To EC Application" wrapper (bank_page.resource, object_list_page.resource, etc.) - each of those only supplies its own screen-specific credential defaults and delegates the actual mechanics here, since Bank's and Object List's wrappers were found to have identical bodies (owner query 2026-08-21) differing only in which credential constants were passed. Lives in common.resource (not browser.resource alone), which aggregates utils.resource - browser.resource deliberately has no Capture Step dependency.

Authenticate as Deferment Group's OWN credentials (sysadmin/sysadmin from credentials.py) on the current page. Standing decision (owner, 2026-08-22): every EC screen gets its own dedicated credential pair. Zero-argument wrapper so deferment_group_iud.robot's test cases read as a plain business step; supplies Deferment Group's own credential defaults to the shared T1 Login To EC Screen (common.resource), which owns the actual login mechanics.

suite.doc: EC IUD Test - Deferment Group (Configuration > Assets > Facility_Objects > Deferment Group, CO.0149). Manage-Object (OV) screen. DELETE = End Date = Start Date (true delete in OV_DEFERMENT_GROUP). Layered: this test -> deferment_group_page (T3) -> manage_object (T2) + common (T1). NEVER touch existing data.
